paragraphs: Netflix, Inc. is an American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios (formerly old Warner Brothers studios) and the Albuquerque Studios (formerly ABQ studios). It owns and operates an eponymous over-the-top subscription video on-demand service, which showcases acquired and original programming as well as third-party content licensed from other production companies and distributors. Netflix is also the first streaming media company to be a member of the Motion Picture Association.

Netflix initially both sold and rented DVDs by mail, but the sales were eliminated within a year to focus on the DVD rental business. In 2007, Netflix introduced streaming media and video on demand. The company expanded to Canada in 2010, followed by Latin America and the Caribbean. In 2011, the service began to acquire and produce original content, beginning with the crime drama Lilyhammer.

The company has been listed on Nasdaq since 2002 and is ranked 117th on the Fortune 500 and 219th on the Forbes Global 2000. It is the largest entertainment/media company by market capitalization as of 2026 estimated at $450 billion. In 2021, Netflix was ranked as the eighth-most trusted brand globally by Morning Consult. During the 2010s, Netflix was the top-performing stock in the S&P 500 stock market index, with a total return of 3,693%.

The company has two CEOs, Greg Peters and Ted Sarandos, who are split between Los Gatos and Los Angeles, respectively. It also operates international offices in Asia, Europe and Latin America including in Canada, France, Brazil, the Netherlands, India, Italy, Japan, Poland, South Korea, and the United Kingdom. The company has production hubs in Los Angeles, Albuquerque, London, Madrid, Vancouver and Toronto.

people.name: David Hyman
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Secretary
people.bio: Hyman has served as Netflix's Chief Legal Officer and Secretary since 2002. Previously, he was General Counsel of Webvan and practiced law at Morrison & Foerster and Arent Fox.
people.quote: As Chief Legal Officer, David is responsible for all legal matters for the Company.

people.name: Spencer Neumann
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Neumann was named Netflix's CFO in January 2019. Previously, he served as CFO of Activision Blizzard and as CFO and executive vice president of Global Guest Experience at Walt Disney Parks and Resorts.
people.quote: Spencer was named CFO of Netflix in January of 2019

people.name: Greg Peters
people.title: co-Chief Executive Officer and President
people.bio: Peters serves as Netflix's co-Chief Executive Officer and President and also serves on the Board.
people.quote:
Greg Peters

people.quote:
Ted Sarandos 
 Co-Chief Executive Officer 
 (principal executive officer)

people.name: Clete Willems
people.title: Chief Global Affairs Officer
people.bio: Willems joined Netflix as Chief Global Affairs Officer in April 2025 and leads its strategic engagement with governments worldwide. Previously, he was a partner at Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld and held government roles in the White House, USTR and Congress.
people.quote: Clete Willems joined Netflix as Chief Global Affairs Officer in April 2025

people.name: Richard Barton
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Co-Executive Chairman of Zillow Group since 2024 and previously its Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman. He founded Expedia and co-founded GlassDoor.
people.quote: In addition, Mr. Barton brings experience with respect to marketing products to consumers through the internet.

people.name: Mathias D pfner
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chairman and CEO of Axel Springer SE since 2002. His earlier roles there included editor-in-chief of Die Welt and membership on the Management Board.
people.quote: As a media executive located in Germany, Mr. D pfner brings international perspective, media experience and business acumen to the Board.

people.name: Reed Hastings
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Co-founded Netflix in 1997 and transitioned from Executive Chairman to non-executive Chairman in April 2025, after previously serving as co-Chief Executive Officer and President. He is a current director but is not standing for re-election.
people.quote: Mr. Hastings has informed the Company of his decision not to stand for re-election at the Annual Meeting.

people.name: Jay Hoag
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Founding General Partner of TCV since 1995 and a technology investor and venture capitalist for more than 43 years. He chairs TCV's Investment Committee and is a member of its Executive Committee.
people.quote: Mr. Hoag is an engaged and effective lead independent director and brings strategic insights and financial experience to the Board.

people.name: Leslie Kilgore
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chief Marketing Officer of Netflix from 2000 to 2012. Previously served as Director of Marketing at Amazon and Brand Manager at Procter & Gamble.
people.quote: As our former Chief Marketing Officer, Ms. Kilgore deeply understands the Netflix business and is able to bring years of marketing experience to the Board.

people.name: Strive Masiyiwa
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Founder and Executive Chairman of Econet Global since 1993. Previously served on Unilever's board from 2016 to 2024 and on the Rockefeller Foundation's board for 15 years.
people.quote: Mr. Masiyiwa has received honorary doctorates from Morehouse College, Yale University, Nelson Mandela University and Cardiff University.

people.name: Ann Mather
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Executive Vice President and CFO of Pixar from 1999 to 2004. Previously served as Executive Vice President and CFO of Village Roadshow Pictures and held executive positions at The Walt Disney Company.
people.quote: Ms. Mather's experience as an executive with several major media companies provides a unique business perspective.

people.name: Elinor Mertz
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Chief Financial Officer of Airbnb since March 2024, following earlier finance leadership roles there. Held finance roles at Netflix from 2006 to 2013, including Vice President, Finance and Investor Relations.
people.quote: Ms. Mertz has served as Chief Financial Officer at Airbnb, Inc., an accommodations and experiences platform, since March 2024.

people.name: Greg Peters
people.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company and Director
people.bio: Co-Chief Executive Officer of Netflix since January 2023. Has held increasingly responsible roles at Netflix since 2008, including Chief Operating Officer and Chief Product Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Peters, our co-Chief Executive Officer, has served in roles of increasing responsibility at Netflix since 2008, including Chief Operating Officer and Chief Product Officer.

people.name: Ambassador Susan Rice
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Former U.S. Domestic Policy Advisor, National Security Advisor and Permanent Representative to the United Nations. Previously served on Netflix's board from 2018 to 2021 before returning in 2023.
people.quote: Ambassador Rice earned her master's degree and doctorate in international relations from Oxford University, where she was a Rhodes Scholar,

people.name: Ted Sarandos
people.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company and Director
people.bio: Co-Chief Executive Officer of Netflix since 2020 and Chief Content Officer from 2000 to January 2023. Led the company's transition into original content production beginning in 2013.
people.quote: Mr. Sarandos, as co-Chief Executive Officer and former Chief Content Officer, has significant executive management and leadership experience and is integral to developing corporate strategy.

people.name: Brad Smith
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Vice Chair and President of Microsoft since 2021, having joined Microsoft in 1993. Previously an associate and then partner at Covington & Burling from 1986 to 1993.
people.quote: With a leading role at Microsoft, Mr. Smith brings broad business and international experience on a variety of issues, including government affairs and public policy to the Board.

people.name: Anne Sweeney
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Former Co-Chair of Disney Media Networks and President of Disney/ABC Television Group. Oversaw Disney's cable, broadcast and satellite properties globally for 18 years.
people.quote: Ms. Sweeney has held various senior positions with large entertainment companies, which provided her with broad strategic and operational experience.
